name: New Economy Coalition
description: A membership network of 200+ nonprofits, mission-driven businesses, grassroots groups, and sectoral associations across the US working to build the scale and power of the solidarity economy movement, with a stated focus on Black, Indigenous, and working-class communities. Founded in 2012 (as a successor to the New Economics Institute). Since 2021 it has operated as a worker self-directed nonprofit with no executive director; decisions are made collectively by staff and elected board representatives through adapted sociocracy.

research.notes: The events listing's most recent entries are from April 2025 and no upcoming dated event is published. NEC does run an Annual All Member Meeting — virtual since 2022, drawing 175+ people from nearly 100 organizations — but no 2026 date is announced and it is members-only, so there is nothing to list yet; worth re-checking when a date appears. No Slack, Discord, or listserv found: members connect through periodic convenings, seven member-led working groups, a member directory, and a newsletter.
